name: Halloween nail art designs
what_it_is: Creators and nail techs showcase Halloween-themed manicures — ghosts, jack-o'-lanterns, spiderwebs, bats, flames and 3D jewels — on almond, square and stiletto nails, some as salon showcases, press-ons or step-by-step tutorials. Videos are posted across October 2026 (with one from late September), all tied to spooky-season nail designs rather than a single event.
